background: Bank of America Corporation is the holding company of the second-largest US bank, spanning consumer banking, wealth management under Merrill and a global corporate and investment bank.
synthesis: All three agencies rate the group, A+ on average and the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, with no rating action since a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 3 May 2023. Capital is the soft spot: CET1 of 11.2% sits in the bottom quarter of US banks and leverage of 5.5% is below the peer median. Liquidity is no better placed, LCR of 112% falling below the median as well, and none of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods, on figures to 30 Jun 2026. The newsflow is mixed, a broker upgrade on 24 Sep 2026 set against earlier warnings over unrealised losses in the bond book and a sharp fall in the shares.
